content.value_statement: Manual spreadsheet updates are slow and error prone. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to append rows through the Google Workspace CLI with clear flags and confirmation.
actual_capabilities: Shows the command syntax for gws sheets +append.
Identifies --spreadsheet as the required spreadsheet ID flag.
Documents --values for simple comma-separated row data.
Documents --range for targeting a specific sheet tab or A1 range.
Warns agents to confirm with the user before executing the write command.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and valid Google Workspace authentication.
Does not validate spreadsheet permissions, ranges, or row values by itself.
Can modify spreadsheet data, so execution should require user confirmation.
Provides append guidance only, not full spreadsheet management.

use_cases.title: Log Form Submissions
use_cases.description: Append new records to a shared sheet after confirming the target spreadsheet, tab, and row values.

use_cases.title: Update Sales Trackers
use_cases.description: Add new lead, quota, or activity rows to a team spreadsheet through a guided CLI workflow.

use_cases.title: Batch Add Sheet Rows
use_cases.description: Prepare a multi-row append request for structured data that must be inserted into Google Sheets.

prompt_templates.title: Append One Row
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one spreadsheet row.
prompt_templates.prompt: Append one row to my Google Sheet. Use spreadsheet ID [ID] and values [values]. Confirm before running the command.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Sheet Tab
prompt_templates.scenario: Append data to a specific tab.
prompt_templates.prompt: Append this row to tab [tab name] in spreadsheet [ID]. Confirm the range and values before executing.

prompt_templates.title: Append Multiple Rows
prompt_templates.scenario: Add several rows in one operation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Append these rows to spreadsheet [ID] with the JSON values option. Check the row shape before execution and ask for confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Automate Verified Append
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a safe append workflow for spreadsheet [ID]. Verify authentication assumptions, target range, values, and confirmation steps before using gws.

output_examples.input: Append Alice, 100, and true to my spreadsheet.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms the spreadsheet ID and values, then reports that the row was appended after user approval.

output_examples.input: Add two records to the Sheet2 tab.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks the tab name, prepares a multi-row append, requests confirmation, and summarizes the completed update.

output_examples.input: Help me append a row but I am unsure which tab to use.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks for the target tab or range before preparing any write operation.

best_practices: Confirm the spreadsheet ID, target tab, and row values before running the write command.
Use the range flag when the target sheet is not the first tab.
Prefer structured row values for bulk appends to reduce parsing mistakes.
anti_patterns: Using an unknown spreadsheet ID or an ambiguous sheet tab.
Mixing comma-separated values that contain unescaped commas.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an AI assistant to append rows to Google Sheets with the gws CLI.

faq.question: Does it require Google authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The gws CLI must be installed and authenticated before a spreadsheet can be updated.

faq.question: Can it append more than one row?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents a JSON values option for multi-row appends.

faq.question: Can it choose a specific sheet tab?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the range option to target a tab or A1 range.

faq.question: Does it modify spreadsheet data?
faq.answer: Yes. It is a write command, so the assistant should ask for confirmation first.

faq.question: Does it manage full spreadsheets?
faq.answer: No. This skill focuses on appending rows, not reading, formatting, or deleting spreadsheet data.
